 RLY  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS

  POLICY AND MANAGEMENT

  MEMORANDUM

TO:  City Council Liaison I Website Steering Committee

FROM:  Keith Sterling, Deputy City Manager
  David Schirmer, Chief Information Officer
  Anne Salvatore, Web Coordinator

DATE:  February 28, 2024

SUBJECT:  Website Design Concept Proposals

ATTACHMENT:  1. Current Project Status and Timeline
  2. Three website template options

INTRODUCTION

This report provides the City Council LiaisonlWebsite Steering Committee of Councilmember
Mirisch and Councilmember Bosse (Liaisons) with an update on the website redesign process
and three website color palettes for review and consideration.

The City Council Liaisons are requested to review and select the colors and approve the site
layout. Additionally, staff is seeking feedback on the website’s Global Navigation as it is
displayed in the presentation.

BACKGROUND

On February 3, 2023, the vendor CivicPlus was selected and awarded the contract for the city
website redesign. In October 2023, staff met with the steering committee to choose a template
to inform the design process by CivicPlus.

Today, staff returns to the committee to review color palette and home page I subpage
layouts. Staff requests the committee choose a color palette and review and provide comments
for the page layouts. There are three options being presented by CivicPlus including a subdued
color palette, richer colors inspired by green and richer colors inspired by blue.

Following the recommendations of the steering committee, CivicPlus will implement the new
design and continue the content migration. Staff is working behind the scenes to refresh and
polish content. Staff and CivicPlus expect to return in late March to unveil the beta site to the
committee.

After the beta site reveal, staff will be trained on the new content management system (CMS)
platform. Staff will continue to refine and organize content for their respective departments
during the time between training and the website launch which is expected in late April.
 RECOMMENDATION

The City Council Liaisons are requested to review and select the colors and approve the site
layout. Additionally, staff is seeking feedback on the website’s Global Navigation as it is
displayed in the presentation.
